inspections.title: Building not safe or clean
inspections.detail: Make sure that the nursing home area is safe, easy to use, clean and comfortable for residents, staff and the public.

inspections.title: No registered nurse on duty as required
inspections.detail: Have a registered nurse on duty 8 hours a day; and  select a registered nurse to be the director of nurses on a full time basis.

inspections.title: Unclean or uncomfortable living space
inspections.detail: Honor the resident's right to a safe, clean, comfortable and homelike environment, including but not limited to receiving treatment and supports for daily living safely.

inspections.title: Resident dignity not respected
inspections.detail: Honor the resident's right to a dignified existence, self-determination, communication, and to exercise his or her rights.

inspections.title: Suspected abuse or neglect not reported on time
inspections.detail: Timely report suspected abuse, neglect, or theft and report the results of the investigation to proper authorities.
inspections.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation

inspections.title: Develop and implement policies and procedures for flu and pneumonia vaccinations
inspections.detail: Develop and implement policies and procedures for flu and pneumonia vaccinations.

inspections.title: COVID-19 vaccine education not done
inspections.detail: Educate residents and staff on COVID-19 vaccination, offer the COVID-19 vaccine to eligible residents and staff after education, and properly document each resident and staff member's vaccination status.

inspections.title: Unclean or uncomfortable living space
inspections.detail: Honor the resident's right to a safe, clean, comfortable and homelike environment, including but not limited to receiving treatment and supports for daily living safely.

inspections.title: Accident hazards or not enough supervision (falls, wandering)
inspections.detail: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.

inspections.title: Incontinence or catheter care problems
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate care for residents who are continent or incontinent of bowel/bladder, appropriate catheter care,  and appropriate care  to prevent urinary tract infections.

inspections.title: Pharmacist drug review not done properly
inspections.detail: Ensure a licensed pharmacist perform a monthly drug regimen review, including the medical chart, following irregularity reporting guidelines in developed policies and procedures.

inspections.title: Infection control not followed
inspections.detail: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

inspections.detail: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

inspections.title: Accident hazards or not enough supervision (falls, wandering)
inspections.detail: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.

inspections.title: Physical restraints used without medical need
inspections.detail: Ensure that each resident is free from the use of physical restraints, unless needed for medical treatment.
inspections.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation

inspections.title: Resident assessment inaccurate
inspections.detail: Ensure each resident receives an accurate assessment.

inspections.title: Psychiatric drugs not reduced or reviewed as required
inspections.detail: Implement gradual dose reductions(GDR) and non-pharmacological interventions, unless contraindicated, prior to initiating or instead of continuing psychotropic medication; and PRN orders for psychotropic medications are only used when the medication is necessary and PRN use is limited.

inspections.title: Hired someone with an abuse/neglect record
inspections.detail: Not hire anyone with a finding of abuse, neglect, exploitation, or theft.
inspections.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation

inspections.title: Staff missing dementia and abuse training
inspections.detail: Give their staff education on dementia care, and what abuse, neglect, and exploitation are; and how to report abuse, neglect, and exploitation.
inspections.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation

bio: For-profit nursing home in Neligh with 70 certified beds, part of Accura Healthcare. Provides 24-hour skilled nursing care, long-term care, and short-term rehab.
